research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Our Next Energy is researching and developing energy storage technologies, as shown by innovations such as active cell vent control for preemptive venting, cells with improved abuse tolerance, and battery packs with partial-power processing DC-DC converters to achieve low power loss and safe operation. Additional work includes electrode design for roll-to-roll lamination, hermetic seal structures, and energy management systems with universal energy flow management. These efforts span cell safety, efficiency, and system integration.

overview_description.description:
Our Next Energy is a developer of energy storage technology to expand access to sustainable power. Our Next Energy focuses on safer battery chemistries that use sustainable raw materials while creating a reliable, low cost and conflict-free supply chain.

The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Novi, Michigan.

about_short_description.short_description: Our Next Energy is a developer of energy storage technology to expand access to sustainable power.

product.name: Aries™ Grid
product.description: A DC energy storage system for residential, commercial, utility-scale, and infrastructure applications, designed to store and deliver electricity with high energy density and LFP-based safety characteristics.

product.name: ONE 314 Ah TTP™ Cell
product.description: A 314 Ah top-terminal prismatic LFP battery cell for residential, commercial, and utility-scale energy storage systems. It provides approximately 1,004.8 Wh of energy capacity and is designed for long operating life.

product.name: ONE 110 Ah OTP™ Cell
product.description: A power-dense, opposed-terminal prismatic LFP battery cell for infrastructure, defense, industrial, and mobility applications. It supports 9.0C pulse discharge, 5.0C pulse charging, and 20–80% DC fast charging in 12 minutes.

product.name: Aries™ LFP
product.description: A 79 kWh lithium iron phosphate battery pack for trucks, boats, and other mobility platforms. It is designed to provide durable onboard energy storage with a stated range of more than 200 miles in applicable vehicle configurations.

product.name: Rail Battery Systems
product.description: Battery products for rail applications that support locomotive fuel-efficiency and durability improvements. ONE develops and manufactures these systems in Michigan for rail operators and equipment customers.
